bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
base="6445896df387d290b6a0517d8cdb72c0471db4c7"
want="0cfc593e1883c2e0a27748d18d8868118354eac1"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled
python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health | grep -q '^USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=PASS$'
session="deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session"
test -f "$session" && test ! -L "$session"
before="$(stat -c '%d:%i:%a' "$session")"
for p in scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py; do
 cmp -s "$p" <(git show "$base:$p") || exit 75
done
umask 077
dir="$HOME/.local/state/gace-userbot-activation/pr47-20261114-a066"
mkdir -p "$dir"
test ! -e "$dir/activated" || exit 76
cp -p scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py "$dir/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
cp -p scripts/userbot_test_client.py "$dir/userbot_test_client.py"
for p in scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py; do
 git show "$want:$p" > "$dir/$(basename "$p").new"
 python3 - "$dir/$(basename "$p").new" <<'PY'
import sys
p=sys.argv[1]
compile(open(p,encoding="utf-8").read(),p,"exec")
PY
done
restore(){
 cp -p "$dir/userbot_resident_ipc.py" scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py
 cp -p "$dir/userbot_test_client.py" scripts/userbot_test_client.py
 systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap restore ERR
cp "$dir/userbot_resident_ipc.py.new" scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py
cp "$dir/userbot_test_client.py.new" scripts/userbot_test_client.py
chmod --reference="$dir/userbot_resident_ipc.py" scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py
chmod --reference="$dir/userbot_test_client.py" scripts/userbot_test_client.py
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service
sleep 5
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled
test "$(stat -c '%d:%i:%a' "$session")" = "$before"
python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health | grep -q '^USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=PASS$'
touch "$dir/activated"
trap - ERR
if output="$(python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py profile_topics_readback 2>&1)"; then
 { printf 'PR47_USERBOT_CODE_ACTIVATION=PASS\nSESSION_IDENTITY_UNCHANGED=YES\nAUTHORIZED_AFTER=YES\n'; printf '%s\n' "$output" | grep -E '^(USERBOT_TEST_RESULT|USERBOT_PROFILE_TOPICS)='; } | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
else
 { printf 'PR47_USERBOT_CODE_ACTIVATION=PASS\nSESSION_IDENTITY_UNCHANGED=YES\nAUTHORIZED_AFTER=YES\nPROFILE_TOPICS_READBACK=FAIL\n'; printf '%s\n' "$output" | tail -c 500; } | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
fi
